## 11. BANK LIABILITY & LIMITATIONS  
### 11.1 What We're Liable For  
We're responsible for:
- ✅ Failing to process transactions correctly
- ✅ Unauthorized transactions (fraud)
- ✅ Breach of confidentiality
- ✅ System failures/outages
name: Chunk 29/42

raw_entities.name: Bank Liability for Transaction Processing Failures
raw_entities.description: FirstUK Bank accepts liability for failures to process customer transactions correctly. This clause establishes the bank's responsibility when transactions are not executed as instructed.
context: We're responsible for: Failing to process transactions correctly

raw_entities.name: Bank Liability for Unauthorized Transactions
raw_entities.description: FirstUK Bank accepts liability for unauthorized transactions and fraud occurring on customer accounts. This clause establishes the bank's responsibility to protect customers from fraudulent activity.

raw_entities.name: Bank Liability for Breach of Confidentiality
raw_entities.description: FirstUK Bank accepts liability for breaches of customer confidentiality. This clause establishes the bank's responsibility to maintain the confidentiality of customer information.
context: We're responsible for: Breach of confidentiality

raw_entities.name: Bank Liability for System Failures and Outages
raw_entities.description: FirstUK Bank accepts liability for system failures and service outages that prevent customers from accessing their accounts or conducting transactions. This clause establishes the bank's responsibility for maintaining operational continuity.
